A neighborhood bakery in Nava Naroda

Poonam Bakery is a neighborhood bakery serving fresh, flavorful cakes, pastries and bakery favorites in Nava Naroda, Ahmedabad. With a strong focus on quality, freshness and friendly service, we aim to make every order special.
